description:
Cast Yawgmoth's Will by paying {2}{B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Eternal Scourge is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to Yawgmoth's Will.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
